title: Cosmic Rural Dreamscape
description: A surreal night landscape depicts a misty rural field with yellow wildflowers, wooden fences, scattered trees, and two red barns under a vibrant nebula-filled sky. The entire scene is enclosed within an ornate, textured frame resembling twisted branches with blue and gold accents.
prompt: A mystical rural night scene with golden fields of wildflowers, wooden fences, scattered trees and red barns in the distance, all under a dramatic colorful nebula and starry sky with swirling purple, blue and yellow cosmic clouds, the entire artwork enclosed in an ornate twisted branch frame with blue and gold details, atmospheric and dreamy lighting
